name: Multi-Grid Voxel Space Management
definition: A data structure that manages a large voxel world by partitioning it into fixed-size sub-grids (VoxelGrid) indexed by a 3D integer coordinate (Vector3i). It provides lookup, insertion, and removal of grids, and maps global voxel coordinates to the correct sub-grid and local voxel index.
summary: Multi-Grid Voxel Space Management is a sparse voxel storage mechanism that partitions a 3D world into fixed-size sub-grids, differing from flat arrays by using hierarchical dictionary-based lookup for efficient spatial locality and dynamic chunk management.
